name: nebula-vault-frontend-tools
description: Formatting and validation tools for Nebula Vault's Django front end

scripts.format: npm run format:assets && npm run format:templates
scripts.check:js: find static/portal/js accounts/static -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n 1 node --check && node --check static/portal/service-worker.js
scripts.check:frontend: npm run check:assets && npm run check:templates && npm run check:js && npm run lint:js && npm run audit:source
